about.headline: Comfortable between business questions and technical details.
about.text: Ryan Scott is a Data Operations Coordinator with a computer science background and experience across SQL reporting, Microsoft Office automation, workflow modernization, QA testing, and software development. He specializes in making messy business data easier to trust and use by building practical tools, improving recurring workflows, supporting migrations, and helping technical and non-technical teams work from the same source of truth.

resume.headline: Practical data operations support with software engineering roots.
resume.text: Ryan brings experience in SQL reporting, Excel/VBA automation, Power Query workflows, iPost Enterprise data prep, Salesforce reporting, migration support, QA-style troubleshooting, and documentation for non-technical handoff.
